items.title: I'm kinda confused on how will the new EU Age Verification thing work on Linux
items.author: /u/I_Love_Ohyas_Thigs
items.content:
Isn't it like physically impossible to enforce on Linux due to its open-source nature? Are they just gonna ban Linux? That's never gonna work BCS Linux is essential to many important governmental electronic devices

Are they just gonna send the police to some random school to check their PCs are not using Linux? Governments using Linux are in the grow, how do you even address that problem?

It's just really stupid overall
